recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reconcile FHIR-51160 separately if the work group wants its later rest.searchParam wording applied; do not change the already-correct resource.searchParam guidance for this seed.
issue_request: FHIR-13406 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked to clarify that CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.searchParam declarations may include supported search-result/control parameters such as _include, _sort, _count, and _summary, in addition to resource-specific and global search parameters.
initial_application: The issue was applied by svn-derived commit f8fabe0b8a8b9d30b5e5551551e7cab7f4af3d83 / svn revision 12800, which added comments to the CapabilityStatement spreadsheet for resource-level and REST-level searchParam elements. The current refactored StructureDefinition source preserves that guidance.
additional_context: The current build's capabilitystatement-base artifact is generated rather than checked in as editable source. It lists the relevant control/result parameters once at CapabilityStatement.rest.searchParam rather than duplicating them under each resource, matching the current comments. Later FHIR-46110 added the current compromise for non-true SearchParameters: omit .definition and use type special. FHIR-51160 asks for a separate rest.searchParam wording correction but remains Resolved - change required.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml already tells implementers to include applicable control parameters such as _sort and _count, and the generated base CapabilityStatement exposes the behavioral parameters at the REST level.
